changeSet.author: nexus-2k8wi
changeSet.comment: The cross pass skips superseded collections: assign_from_chashes_384/768/1024 (the cross branch), cross_preview_384/768/1024 and the cross-collection branch of taxonomy_ann_query_384/768/1024 exclude the centroids of any collection whose catalog_collections row has a non-empty superseded_by. A supersede tombstone keeps its centroids (a rename tombstone's are re-homed), so a live collection's chunks could attach to a retired collection's topics and grow their doc_count. The filter in assign_from_chashes and cross_preview is an uncorrelated ARRAY(SELECT ...) beside the existing "collection <> source" test, which the planner runs as an InitPlan and applies as a filter on the pinned HNSW index scan; in the unpinned taxonomy_ann_query it is a top-level NOT EXISTS over catalog_collections, which the planner turns into an anti-join under the HNSW index scan. Signatures, grants, the function-level plan_cache_mode and the one-signature post-condition are vectors-031-1's. No data effect: function definitions and grants only.
